title: DAG topology executor (topo sort, multi-input/output stages)
description:
## Goal

Branching-DAG topology executor: topological sort,
multi-input / multi-output stage scheduling, build-time
type-check via connector typestate, runtime detection of cyclic
graphs.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor for
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Pipeline with fan-out / fan-in compiles via connector
  typestate; runtime topo sort produces correct execution order;
  attempt to wire a cycle yields a typed error (no panic).

## Non-goals

Turbo / feedback-loop topology is out of scope (epic non-goals).
